purpose: Envelope discrimination: among three competing descending candidate bar highs the upper log-hull selects the shallowest dominating line B*=(45,92), rejecting (20,96) and (70,80). Reproduces the spec §8 worked example exactly.

params.eps_break_note: eps=0.005 is used here to match the spec §8 worked example exactly; eps_break stays illustrative, not locked (HD-03).

rejection_rationale.rejected_because: Its line is pierced by the t=45 high (92) beyond eps; the shallow line pokes under the intervening high.
Its steeper line passes far below the t=45 high (92), which pierces hugely.

rejection_rationale.candidate: B*=(45,92) itself piercing any intervening high
rejection_rationale.rejected_because: The selected line dominates both (20,96) and (70,80) within eps -> it is the valid envelope.

key_inequalities: Candidacy is over ALL later bar highs (§6); the three competing candidates that matter here are (20,96),(45,92),(70,80).
Hull selects the shallowest valid line -> B*=(45,92).
geometry_check.notes: Direct reproduction of trendline-specification.md §8 worked example (eps=0.005). All intervening filler highs sit strictly below the envelope, so the only candidates that can bind the hull are the three named ones; pivot status plays no part in candidacy (§6, D-TL-03/D-TL-05, HD-11). B* is unchanged by that clarification.
